target_customer: Small and medium residential developers of pre sold affordable housing in the Philippines and Indonesia
problem: Developers wait for bank mortgage take out after buyers are approved, leaving a financing gap that stalls new projects.
business_model: Short term unsecured bridge loans with interest only payments and principal at maturity

founders.name: Joseph Tan
previous_startups: Canadian self storage platform scaled to a $310MM exit (as described on the company site)
founders.background_notes: Described as former real estate executive who invested in and developed $3B+ of real estate in North America (company page).

founders.name: Emmanuel Rex Rodriguez
founders.background_notes: Described as a hands on developer who managed million dollar infrastructure budgets (company page). YC page lists Tan only; Rodriguez named on the company page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Lending operations and underwriting are the hard part, not the software, which is a standard loan workflow.

defensibility.rationale: Developer relationships and underwriting data on pre sold units help, but capital and credit access are the real constraint and are replicable by banks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in sources opened.

market_need_then: The YC page cites a roughly $1 trillion Southeast Asian housing backlog. The company site describes the gap between approval of the buyer's loan and bank take out disbursement.

brand_strength.rationale: Search found only a 1997 trademark for an unrelated US firm with a similar name; no brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Express Building is an active Singapore based lender to Philippine and Indonesian housing developers, listed with a team of 14. No funding, traction or outcome data is public in the sources found, so its trajectory cannot be judged beyond survival to the present.
notes: No funding announcement found in two searches; seed trackers were gated. Competitor search surfaced Lhoopa (affordable housing developer) and Ringkas (Indonesian mortgage platform) but neither was a developer bridge lender and no dated source near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Founder prior employers and education not found.
